media.prompt: SVD Text to Image to Video: sample from ComfyUI's template library
media.note: From ComfyUI's template library (MIT). Not rendered on this machine yet.

what: Turns one still into a short clip of 14 or 25 frames.
dossier:
If the task is Text-to-Video and high quality is required, Then consider Mochi 1, provided the missing DiT weights can be acquired or the workflow is adjusted, as it offers high-fidelity motion and strong prompt adherence [SOURCES.md].
   If the task is Text-to-Video and local files must be used strictly, Then use CogVideoX-5B, as its diffusion models and VAE are present locally [MODEL.md].
   If the task is Image-to-Video and the input is a still image, Then use SVD (specifically stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt for 25 frames or stable-video-diffusion-img2vid for 14 frames), noting that it cannot be controlled by text [MODEL.md].
   If the task is Video Continuation, Then use CogVideoX,
